t:
(a) None of the funds available to the Department of Defense for any fiscal year for drug interdiction or counterdrug activities may be transferred to any other department or agency of the United States except as specifically provided in an appropriations law. 
    (b) None of the funds available to the Central Intelligence Agency for any fiscal year for drug interdiction and counter-drug activities may be transferred to any other department or agency of the United States except as specifically provided in an appropriations law.

fable.w: This section only restricts transfers of Department of Defense and CIA counterdrug funds to other federal departments or agencies unless an appropriations law specifically provides for it. A tempting reading treats the inter-agency transfer language as coordination, but every actor is inside the federal government and no consultation, hearing, comment process, advisory body, or right to sue is created for any outside party.

qwen_block.w: This section restricts the transfer of funds between federal agencies (Department of Defense, CIA, and other departments/agencies). It does not involve consultation, coordination, or participation with any entities outside the federal government, such as states, tribes, the public, or private organizations. The actors involved are entirely within the federal government.
qwen_block.s: None of the funds available to the Department of Defense for any fiscal year for drug interdiction or counterdrug activities may be transferred to any other department or agency of the United States except as specifically provided in an appropriations law.

opus.w: The section only limits transfers of counterdrug funds between federal departments and agencies unless an appropriations law allows it. Everyone involved (DoD, CIA, other federal agencies and Congress) is inside the federal government, so no outside party consults on, comments on or challenges any decision. Someone might read the 'except as specifically provided in an appropriations law' clause as a kind of approval process, but that would be Congress acting, and Congress is inside the federal government.
opus.s: None of the funds available to the Department of Defense for any fiscal year for drug interdiction or counterdrug activities may be transferred to any other department or agency of the United States except as specifically provided in an appropriations law.

qwen_chat.w: This section restricts the transfer of funds between federal agencies (Department of Defense, CIA, and other US departments/agencies). All entities mentioned are inside the federal government. There is no requirement for consultation, coordination, or participation by any outside party (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities) in the decision-making process described.
qwen_chat.s: None of the funds available to the Department of Defense for any fiscal year for drug interdiction or counterdrug activities may be transferred to any other department or agency of the United States except as specifically provided in an appropriations law.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the text mentions "drug interdiction" and "counterdrug activities," it implies some form of coordination with external entities (like foreign governments or local law enforcement). However, the text itself only restricts the *transfer of funds* between federal departments/agencies. It does not mandate any consultation, hearing, or participation by outside parties in the decision-making process regarding these funds or activities. The actors involved (DoD, CIA, other federal departments) are all inside the federal government.
